meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 配置并校验计算流体仿真,让模拟稳定可靠、安全续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用计算流体仿真做科研数值模拟,需要确认设置准确并安全重启任务
copy.tagline_en: Set up and validate fluid-flow simulations for stable, safe runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run computational fluid dynamics simulations and need sound setup and safe restarts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 的 FluidSim 框架帮你选求解器、配参数、跑流体仿真并出图:2D/3D Navier-Stokes、浅水、层结流等,支持 FFT 与 MPI 并行、频谱和涡量输出。
howto.when: 当你要运行流体力学仿真、挑选 FluidSim 求解器或审查仿真参数(含 FFT/MPI 配置、输出诊断、重启兼容)时触发。

say.text: 用 ns2d 求解器跑一个 256×256 的二维湍流仿真
say.note: 会生成默认参数并启动仿真

say.text: 把 params.nu_2 改成 1e-4,t_end 设为 50 后重跑
用 load_sim_for_plot 加载上次结果并画涡量图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can pick a FluidSim solver, configure parameters, run CFD simulations and plot results — 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flows — with FFT, MPI parallel runs, spectra and vorticity output.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you run fluid dynamics simulations, choose a FluidSim solver, or review simulation parameters, including FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics and restart compatibility.

say_en.text: Run a 256x256 2D turbulence simulation with the ns2d solver
say_en.note: Creates params and starts the run

say_en.text: Change params.nu_2 to 1e-4, set t_end to 50 and rerun
Load the last run with load_sim_for_plot and plot vorticity
